checkpoints.header: Independently reconstruct and adversarially review RESULT.md and exact source packet. Verify nonempty prefix receiver view, fixed joint carrier, positive counting fibers and total, legal deletion as a leaf of receiver view even when not an ambient leaf, exact P1 fiber composition, and the same receiver index without assigning parent vertices as receivers. Reconstruct seven-vertex first-response grade vectors, ambient cone totals, balanced-source grounded field values, scalar and edge multiset collisions, and vertex-value separation for nonzero alpha. Challenge representations being mistaken for actual update, ownership, preparation, access, local availability, or a physical conservation law. Check history independence uses the fixed ambient carrier and does not remove the ambient reference from the evaluated representation. Additions are outside the pushforward-action claim. The manuscript credits inherited P1 and T-126; there is no new general theorem or empirical validation claim. Do not use T-126's unverified scratch counts as evidence and do not certify them. Check the original T-125 counting representation is distinguished from the newly selected m_Z. Return JSON with verdict ACCEPTED, REVISE or FAIL; findings, missing_assumptions, counterexamples, limitations and constructive_analysis arrays; native_bridge_status NOT_DERIVED or DERIVED_FROM_SOURCES; next_native_obligation string. Strict schema: findings contains only defects needing correction; ACCEPTED requires findings=[], missing_assumptions=[], counterexamples=[].
